text: PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Obtain one clean ESD kitting tray for the Widget Mount Assembly (DWG-4500-01) per STD-1000 and place a layer of anti-static foam into the tray.
Make individual license plates for each assembly kitted, as shown in Figure 1, containing the assembly part number, production order number, and serial number per STD-1300.
Figure 1: Completed label for the Assy Part Name
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Obtain the Bracket (PN-1001). Check the Bracket for dents, cuts and scratches (see Op 0200 for inspection criteria). If damaged, contact supervision.
If required, clean the Bracket with isopropyl alcohol per STD-1400. Do not immerse the unit in an alcohol bath. Blow dry and place the Bracket face down.
Clean (do not prime) four (4) tuning screws. Install the four tuning screws into the cavities using a 2.5 mm hex key until snug. Back the four screws out five (5) complete 360 degree revolutions.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Place four (4) adhesive-backed EMI gaskets (PN-1002) onto the bracket flanges as shown. Center each gasket over the opening. Alignment fixture FIX-2200 may be used.
Install until snug and then back out 5 complete turns
Clean and apply threadlocker (Loctite 242) to twenty-two (22) screws (PN-1008) per STD-1500 using ADH-100-A or ADH-100-B. Record cure time information per STD-1500 in operator comments.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Place the Network Assembly (PN-1004) onto the skin. Verify proper orientation by aligning the screw holes as shown.
Install the Network Assembly to the skin using twenty-two (22) screws. Torque screws to 4.0 in-lbs using a TOOL-TQ-05 torque wrench.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Install three (3) bullet connectors (PN-1011) to the Housing (PN-1005) using tool TOOL-INS-01 or equivalent.
Loosely attach the two brackets to the Housing using four (4) screws (PN-1009) and four (4) washers (PN-1006). Do not tighten the screws at this time.
Screw Washer note: hardware may not look exactly like the picture
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Remove the backing from two (2) gaskets. Align and install the two gaskets to the Network Assembly with the adhesive side toward the assembly.
Install the Housing to the Network Assembly by aligning the three (3) bullet connectors with the mating connectors. Carefully press the Housing until the three connectors fully engage.

Attach the brackets to the Network Assembly using four (4) screws and four (4) washers. Torque these four screws first to 6.0 in-lbs using a TOOL-TQ-05 torque wrench. Torque the four previously installed screws to 6.0 in-lbs.
XXXXX-1 Screws (4 pls.) XXXXX-1 Washers (4 pls.)
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Connect the assembly to the functional test station per STD-1600 and record the results in SYS-TRACK.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Apply threadlocker to the four (4) skin setscrews per STD-1500 using ADH-100-C. Do not prime the screws.
Inspect workmanship per STD-1700 and STD-1750. Verify the sealing compound cure time for the tuning screws is recorded in operator comments per STD-1500.
Inspect the skin surface finish per the following: gouges and scratches in Zone A shall not exceed 0.060 in. When in doubt, contact the Project Engineer.
